title: 1910s Family Group Portrait, Vintage Sepia Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Elzora (shortest) (Marks) Crowley Looks like her sister Sarah Marks Brown Mother's sisters Don't know the man
description: An early 20th-century sepia snapshot depicting two sisters and an unidentified young man standing outdoors. The man wears a classic 1910s flat newsboy cap, suit jacket, and tie, while the women wear simple period dresses. Handwritten notes on the reverse identify the women as 'Mother's sisters' Elzora Marks Crowley and Sarah Marks Brown, adding personal genealogical interest to the portrait.
